description: Elections Commission - Declare that S. Ajeethkumar as a member of the Valikamam North Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Valikamam North Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member's failure to attend meetings, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process at the local authority level, specifically the nomination and declaration of a new elected member, which falls under the Elections classification type.
